bullets.text: Chennai cops whisked away economist A Kalaiyarasan from his Adyar residence over a fake social media post, and the office should monitor police actions.
The Chennai meteorological department warned of heavy rain in Thiruvallur district from November 3, and the office should coordinate relief preparations.
Ponneri municipality refused to accept garbage, leaving the panchayat without a dumping site, and the district team must intervene to resolve waste management.
Gummidipoondi traders detained a highways department vehicle over pavement issues, and local officials should engage merchants to restore order.
Ambattur court granted bail to DMK councillor Dheeta Saravanan after his controversial remarks about Chief Minister Vijay, and the office should watch legal developments.
The Tamil Nadu government allocated Rs 50 crore for startups to attract international game studios and AI companies, and the portfolio team should track investments.
L&T's Vyoma.AI performed groundbreaking for a 52-data centre project in Chennai, and the digital services team should monitor project progress.
Tamil Nadu plans restricted Wi-Fi and gaming curricula to protect students, and the IT department should oversee policy implementation.
AMMK general secretary TTV Dhinakaran criticized the government over generator issues at the Thirumazhisai electric crematorium, and the office should watch political fallout.
